narrative.overview: The app is a paper application form that agencies stamp. A grey desk holds near-white sheets ruled in 1px graphite boxes with square corners. Filled values and the primary action are ballpoint blue; serials, step numbers and corrections are rubber-stamp red. Stamps are the one theatrical device: rotated slightly, double-bordered, pressed in with a short thunk.
keyCharacteristics: Flat ruled boxes, 1px graphite, near-square corners (2px)
Three inks only: graphite, ink-blue, stamp-red
Mitr for headings and stamp lettering, Sarabun for printed form text
Stamps are rotated, double-bordered, ink-textured, multiply-blended
Sample content is labeled as sample; no invented agencies

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Blue means the user's own action or data; red means the system's mark or a problem. A third accent hue does not exist.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Tinted Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from graphite 1px lines, not from colored fills or tinted panels.

rules.name: The Thai Line-Height Rule
rules.body: Never set Thai text below 1.4 line-height; body sits at 1.65 to 1.7.

rules.name: The Paper On Desk Rule
rules.body: One soft lift for sheets; every other element is flat with a 1px rule.

dos: Do build every surface from sheets on the desk and ruled 1px graphite cells.
Do reserve ink-blue for user action and data, and stamp-red for system marks and errors.
Do label stamp examples as samples.
Do keep 44px minimum targets and the 2px focus outline in ink-blue.
donts: Don't use a hero photo, a service-card grid or a generic blue portal look.
Don't round corners beyond 2px (3px on stamps only) or use pill shapes.
Don't add shadows beyond the sheet lift.
Don't stamp-effect everything; stamps are marks of agency action, not decoration.
